verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's documented reporting API uses a versioned path (POST to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices), which is a thin first-party sign of API versioning. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, version lifecycle, or changelog commitments for API versions. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning scheme or lifecycle documentation, and evidence of version migration guidance.
